body:
## DM-270 evidence detail (worker)

Branch `space-DM-270`, commits ffc871f (DM-189/190), 4efeaa3 (DM-186/187), cc03a20 (DM-184/185 + scratch removal), b112948 (DM-188/191 + scratch/DM-188 removal). 14 new test files, 258 tests; helpers src/test/{crossRepoWorld,correctionWorld,experimentWorld,outcomeWorld}.ts (new), src/test/repoEnv.ts (additive: DOMAIN_TABLES + experiment_events).

### c1 criterion -> test
- DM-184 c1 -> src/core/plan/experiments.test.ts: 'DM-184 c1: … of a source by subject' (own-source identity, baseline read from the grade, every planning field stored), '… of source references' (earlier-source seals; unknown subject/report/assessment refused), '… of metric references' (each wrong unit for each measure, points >100, fractional counts, unmeasured S.score), 'stable experiment identity' (minted ids; restated id kept; restating from another sprint/source/by own subject/unminted/listed twice refused), 'target descriptor and required planning fields' (folder vs single repo; each of the 10 fields missing refused).
- DM-184 c2 -> src/core/plan/retroExperiments.test.ts (legacy fixture bytes+hashes through normalizeRetro and submit, retroSections rendering, search parts, retroIsEmpty, checkpoint retro gate); src/core/repo/experimentRecords.test.ts 'prose-only run history keeps its bytes' (no new keys, identical re-export, `experiments: []` refused on import).
- DM-184 c3 -> src/core/services/experimentEvents.test.ts 'later events never change the approved source', 'who may record events, and when'; experimentRecords.test.ts export/import provenance with no machine data, edited provenance refused (5 edits: baseline value, baseline state, input hash, snapshot seal, another epic; dumpDomain unchanged), edited report refused, A->B->C re-export.
- DM-184 c4 -> experiments.test.ts 'the checked-in experiment cases' (table over experiment-cases.json: 32 rejected with the fixture's error and nothing stored, 4 accepted, 3 normalized) + 'a structured/prose mix says where each part goes'.
- DM-185 c1 -> src/core/plan/retroFindings.test.ts 'DM-185 c1: findings rank concrete observed gaps', '… show magnitude, coverage, origins and ticket names', '… stay deterministic and show unmeasured tickets', '… corrective concentration needs a strict majority'.
- DM-185 c2 -> retroFindings.test.ts 'proposals tell code, plan, tooling and evidence gaps apart', 'unavailable evidence and valid exploration'; experiments.test.ts 'DM-185 c2: valid exploration is not waste'.
- DM-185 c3 -> experiments.test.ts 'DM-185 c3: vague proposed work is told from specific work' (review F3 vague/specific tables); experimentEvents.test.ts 'vague or unsized work cannot be silently scheduled'; retroFindings.test.ts 'a proposal outline is measurable, routed, and holds no work'.
- DM-185 c4 -> retroFindings.test.ts 'DM-185 c4: edge cases stay deterministic and invent no work' (no meaningful issue, sparse, contradictory, several candidate causes, no experiment written).
- DM-186 c1 -> src/core/services/corrections.test.ts 'DM-186 c1: the preview lists the work before anything is materialized' (target sprint, sized tickets with criteria, Fireguard requiring them, one acceptance node covering each; preview writes nothing) + '… the preview of a completed epic's work'.
- DM-186 c2 -> corrections.test.ts 'DM-186 c2: the target follows the source epic' (appended/future sprint; unfinished refused a follow-up, completed refused a sprint) + 'DM-186 c2: a completed epic gets a follow-up epic' (distinct backlog epic, source unchanged).
- DM-186 c3 -> corrections.test.ts 'DM-186 c3: stable idempotency keys in the unfinished epic' (repeat adds nothing after renames; other payload/target -> idempotency_mismatch) + '… across Save and follow-up renames'.
- DM-186 c4 -> corrections.test.ts 'DM-186 c4: created work follows the normal rules; no grade grants anything' (draft-editing roles only; validates, grants nothing; person saves/adopts normally; follow-up run only after Save).
- DM-187 review matrix -> corrections.test.ts four 'DM-187 expectedDraftRevision matrix: …' describes (undefined/null/number x no draft / open draft / already created / completed epic, incl. 'An open draft now exists').
- DM-188 c1 -> src/core/services/experimentOutcomes.test.ts 'DM-188 c1: an experiment resolves to its corrective tickets, their run and the assessments of its results' (own epic, exact baseline/target/after, follow-up epic).
- DM-188 c2 -> src/core/plan/experimentOutcome.test.ts four 'DM-188 c2: …' describes (boundaries -30% improved/-31%… , +30% regressed, -27,000 vs -27,001; order-independent; insufficient for no result/not landed/stated/missing/estimated/other unit/own baseline grade/not here/outside window/other policy/other size/other size mix; unsized vs unsized classifies).
- DM-188 c3 -> experimentOutcome.test.ts two 'DM-188 c3: …' describes (breach sweep, lower time with breach, unreadable guardrail, breach missing/estimated, outside window, in-window breach beats later clean result).
- DM-188 c4 (data) -> src/core/repo/experimentEvents.test.ts 'DM-188 c4: result events are append-only, …' + R1/R2/R7 describes.
- DM-189 c1 -> src/main/desktop/sourceCheckout.test.ts 'DM-189 c1: associating a tracked or selected checkout after validation' (4 tests incl. initialize through openWorkspace).
- DM-189 c2 -> sourceCheckout.test.ts 'DM-189 c2: canonical aliases resolve to one target', 'DM-189 c2: revalidation before mutation' (moved, link-replaced, other project, unreadable record, untracked); src/main/desktop/crossRepoCorrections.test.ts 'DM-189 c2 / DM-190 c1: the target is the revalidated chosen checkout, never a renderer path'.
- DM-189 c3 -> sourceCheckout.test.ts 'DM-189 c3: installed apps, unrelated repositories and missing clones stay unavailable' + '… missing clones and unrelated repositories, no clone or redirect'.
- DM-190 c1 -> src/core/services/crossRepoCorrections.test.ts 'DM-190 c1: a distinct target-owned epic with a complete draft and portable provenance' + 'DM-190 c1: refusals before anything is created'.
- DM-190 c2 -> crossRepoCorrections.test.ts (core) 'DM-190 c2: retries recover the same target ids; conflicting payloads fail', 'DM-190 c2: partial progress and shared keys' (incl. earliest held epic under a shared key); main crossRepoCorrections.test.ts 'DM-190 c2: failures are reported and conflicting payloads fail'.
- DM-190 c3 -> core crossRepoCorrections.test.ts 'DM-190 c3: source history unchanged; target state independent'.
- DM-270 c4 -> main crossRepoCorrections.test.ts 'DM-270 c4 / DM-190 c2: a retry after a partial failure yields one target epic and unchanged source history' (SQLite trigger fails the link write; 1 target epic; source history snapshot equal); corrections.test.ts 'DM-270 c4: a creation that fails part way leaves one target and the source history byte-identical on retry' (trigger fails the draft.corrected event insert after draft + follow-up epic were written).
- DM-191 review (R8) -> src/core/plan/correctionHolders.test.ts (advC's 14 holder variants as a table, 5 follow-up variants, binding, scope starts, seal and regrade); experimentOutcomes.test.ts 'DM-191 c4 (DM-270 R8)' describes; experimentEvents.test.ts 'DM-191 c1/c2 (DM-270 R8)'.

### c2 mutation record (each restored; final runs on restored code)
- plan/experiments.ts requireUnit + DEFERRED disabled -> 'refuses every unit that is not the measure's own…', 'rejects invalid metric unit: a time baseline stated in tokens', '…a guardrail count stated in points', 'reads "To be decided…" as vague'. Key max back to 500 -> 'accepts a 200-character carried key and refuses a 201-character one'.
- plan/retroFindings.ts '<=' -> '<' majority, zero guardrails kept -> 'finds no concentration in an even split…', 'guards nothing with a measure at zero…'; confirmed failure -> code only + no names -> 'reads a delivery gap from a confirmed failure…', 'names tickets by key and title…'.
- repo/importer.ts forgedSource disabled + portable.ts writtenContent bypassed -> 5 'refuses … keeping everything this machine holds' + 're-exports a report written without followUps…'; importer incoming.has(byNumber.id) dropped -> all 3 R1 two-machine tests.
- schemas.ts union message back to Invalid input; retro.ts experiments not counted in retroIsEmpty; services/experiments.ts gate only on completed -> 'refuses an experiment without a source…', 'counts a prose entry or an experiment as a retro', 'refuses to schedule, start or complete it…'. services/experiments.ts same-project check disabled -> 'neither lists nor records a grade of this project's epic held in another checkout…'.
- normalize.ts references kept as given -> 5 F1 tests; plan/corrections.ts Fireguard keeps first marker only -> 'applyCorrections still attaches its own markers…'; startsProblem held&&!moved -> held||!moved -> 'refuses scope starts for the cited scorecard's sprint…'.
- draftOps.ts limit +1 -> 'a full 100-reference edit of a marked ticket is refused…'.
- services/corrections.ts heldFollowUp removed -> F2 reuse + matrix; draft-gone branch disabled -> matrix number tests; missing sprint coded conflict -> F4 not_found tests; payload hash ignored -> both c3 idempotency_mismatch tests.
- plan/experimentOutcome.ts '>=' -> '>' -> 'reads 30,000 -> 21,000 …', 'divides an absolute expected change …'. services/experimentOutcomes.ts draft-only filter removed -> R3 test. repo/finalizer.ts guard bypassed -> 2 shared-checkout R1 tests.
- main/desktop/sourceCheckout.ts revalidate skips canonical!==path -> 'refuses a path replaced by a link to another folder (relocated, project_mismatch)'. core/services/crossRepoCorrections.ts epicWithKey DESC -> 'holds the earliest epic when two epics share a key…'. main/desktop/crossRepoCorrections.ts refused() keeps receipt -> 'conflicting payload reuse fails: … the receipt this call wrote is removed'.

### c3 product fixes (each pinned)
1 DM-184: src/test/repoEnv.ts DOMAIN_TABLES gains experiment_events.
2 DM-184: structured/prose mixes and a missing/invalid source give specific messages (schemas.ts) instead of bare 'Invalid input'.
3 DM-184: docs/architecture.md 'Experiment and report history across machines' documents inherent tail truncation (and the re-hashed no-scorecard legacy report, pinned as a control).
4 DM-184 (R6): an imported result on another epic's grade — closed by holder check + canonical reference match; pinned, no code change.
5 DM-185: two-hop import — portable.ts writtenContent: export leaves out exactly the default-valued keys whose absence restores the content hash; A->B->C pinned. Two portable.test.ts expectations that asserted the filled-content-under-unfilled-hash export (refused on import by editedReport) were updated to the as-written content + hash invariant.
6 DM-185: retroFindings.ts delivery_gap reads a confirmed failure via the failed ticket's verification hypotheses (consistent multiple_candidate_causes); zero-valued guardrails dropped (no 'at_least 0'); concentration requires a strict majority; coverage.items: coordination_problem null, delivery_gap = items whose state rests on reviewed evidence, doc rewritten.
7 DM-187: findings statements name tickets 'DM-6 "Title"' (services/retroFindings passes names), no tk_ ids.
8 DM-186 F3: vagueness — DEFERRED check, generic scope words as filler, PLACEHOLDER only as a standalone marker; review cases pinned.
9 DM-186 F1 / DM-188 (3): buildTicket drops correction markers on every created ticket; applyCorrections attaches them.
10 DM-186 F2: new experiments of a completed epic join its open follow-up (heldFollowUp).
11 DM-186 F4: missing sprint -> not_found, passed/in-progress/foreign -> conflict, with a target message, no restatement advice.
12 DM-186 F5: draftOps updateTicket refuses kept markers + edit over LIMITS.references.
13 DM-187: expectedDraftRevision as a number with no open draft refused ('The draft is gone …').
14 DM-188 R1: finalizer requireWritableRunHistory refuses (conflict, entry waits) exporting a run history whose tracked file is not the last synced when another machine owns the run or the file holds events this machine lacks; importer merges arriving events for the owner, imports the whole history for a non-owner holding events the file lacks, renumbers this machine's unexported events after incoming ones and queues an export; same-number statuses on two machines and rewritten events still refused. outbox.enqueueOutbox takes Pick<Ctx,'db'|'clock'>.
15 DM-188 R2: a result citing a follow-up epic/scorecard not here imports; outcome reads insufficient ('not here'); afterOf rechecks located results with resultProblem.
16 DM-188 R3: draft-only holders in other epics ignored.
17 DM-188 R5 (decision): a result citing an unreadable grade (not here, failed seal, mismatched) can never be improved -> insufficient_evidence with the reason; regressed/unchanged kept.
18 DM-191: same-project receipts no longer listed as citable; recording refuses them saying to bring that checkout's records through Git and cite directly; startsProblem: carried starts must match the cited scorecard's own; carried key max 500 -> 200 (receipt key limit).
19 scratch/DM-189/world.ts baseClone clones into a unique mkdtemp then renames into place.

### c5
No vi.mock/vi.fn/vi.spyOn/fake timers in any new test or helper (grep: 0); partial failures via SQLite triggers on real databases; fixed clocks/ids; fresh world per test; temp folders only via per-test mkdtemp (cross-repo/checkout tests) removed afterwards; no git clone. Shuffle run (--sequence.shuffle seed 4242) of the 14 files: 258 pass. Scratch: deleted scratch/DM-185 entirely and every demonstration (c*.ts, *.out.txt, review-fixes) in scratch/DM-184, DM-186, DM-188, DM-189, DM-190; their world.ts files stay because scratch/DM-191 (world.ts, c2-integrity, c2-recovery, c3-no-execution, c4-measure) imports them (and DM-190/world imports DM-184/186/189 worlds).
